Spring message for regular visitors
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Spring Travel Notice

Travelers need to check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk early and keep pet papers close at hand so we can move things along without trouble. Our team is handling a lot of routine requests right now, and small delays can build fast if details are missing.

The senior coordinator is keeping a close eye on daily service calls, and every animal gets patient attention from trained staff before any trip goes forward. If your carrier needs a quick look, or if your pet seems unsettled, tell us right away so we can sort it out before you head out. Please stay with your animal until the desk says you are clear.

Aurelia Skyways is counting on travelers to follow the usual checks and stay ready for a quick update from staff. If you need help with a pet on the move, come straight to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
